selected_records.title: Conversational versus Dashboard Explainable AI for UAV Intrusion Detection: An Empirical Study of Operator Trust and Reliance

article.body:
**ArXiv study compares conversational and dashboard AI interfaces for UAV intrusion detection**

An arXiv record dated 11 August 2026 lists an empirical study titled "Conversational versus Dashboard Explainable AI for UAV Intrusion Detection: An Empirical Study of Operator Trust and Reliance." The study compares two types of AI interfaces for UAV intrusion detection, but the record does not provide an abstract or results.

The study does not specify a UAV platform, autonomy level, sensors, payload, or test environment. No operational capability demonstration, production status, or deployment is established by the available information. The record only identifies the comparison of interface types and operator trust and reliance.
